maddeler.e:
تحاسبت (form VI)
# تَحَاسَبْتُ (taḥāsabtu) /ta.ħaː.sab.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَحَاسَبَ (taḥāsaba)
# تَحَاسَبْتَ (taḥāsabta) /ta.ħaː.sab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَحَاسَبَ (taḥāsaba)
# تَحَاسَبْتِ (taḥāsabti) /ta.ħaː.sab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَحَاسَبَ (taḥāsaba)
# تَحَاسَبَتْ (taḥāsabat) /ta.ħaː.sa.bat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
